name: CV Builder
title: Free CV Builder: Make a Print-Ready CV in Your Browser
description: Build a clean CV with a classic or sidebar layout, optional photo and your choice of colour. Print or save it as a PDF. Nothing is uploaded.
lead: Fill in your details, pick a layout and save your CV as a PDF in a few minutes.
intro: A CV is read in seconds, so it must be clear. This builder puts your details into a clean, printable layout. Choose a classic one-column CV or a sidebar CV, pick an accent colour and add a photo if the job asks for one.
Everything you type stays in your browser. You can save a copy in this browser to edit later, and delete it at any time. Press print and choose Save as PDF to get a file you can email.
how: Fill in your details, then your experience with the latest job first.
Write one achievement per line. They become bullet points.
Choose a layout and colour. The preview on the page is exactly what prints.
Press Print or save as PDF. Choose Save as PDF as the destination and turn off headers and footers.
example: Instead of 'Responsible for sales', write 'Grew monthly sales of a 5-person team by agreeing new accounts with 12 shops'. Numbers and results show what you actually did. Only use figures that are true for you.
mistakes: Sending the same CV to every job. Change the profile and skills to match the advert.
Typing mistakes. Read it aloud once.
Adding ID numbers or details that the employer does not need.
A long CV. One or two pages is enough for most people.

faq.a: Follow the job advertisement. Some employers ask for a photo and many do not. The photo is optional here.
No. It stays in your browser. If you press Save in this browser, a copy is kept on this device only, without the photo.

faq.q: How do I get a PDF?
faq.a: Press Print or save as PDF and choose Save as PDF as the printer. Turn off headers and footers.
We cannot promise that. Plain layouts with real text usually copy and upload better than designed ones, and the classic layout is the plainer of the two.

disclaimer: This tool formats the details you type. It does not check facts, guarantee interviews or give career advice. Read your CV and letter carefully before you send them.
